canonical_sql_candidate: WITH cash_by_order AS (SELECT p.order_id, SUM(CASE p.txn_type WHEN 'CAPTURE' THEN p.amount_vnd ELSE -p.amount_vnd END) AS net_cash_vnd FROM PAYMENT_TRANSACTIONS p WHERE p.txn_status='POSTED' AND p.occurred_at_utc >= '2024-12-31T17:00:00.000Z' AND p.occurred_at_utc < '2025-12-31T17:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY p.order_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(net_cash_vnd) AS s,COUNT(*) AS n FROM cash_by_order) SELECT CASE WHEN s IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s>=0 THEN CAST((2*s+n)/(2*n) AS INTEGER) ELSE -CAST((2*ABS(s)+n)/(2*n) AS INTEGER) END AS avg_net_cash_vnd FROM totals

semantic_slots.classification: Ranking / Challenging: unit-partitioned top-k with boundary ties
semantic_slots.brief: Xếp hạng SKU theo tổng lượng đặt trong các đơn đã xác nhận, riêng trong từng đơn vị cơ sở; trả SKU, tên sản phẩm, đơn vị cơ sở, tổng lượng theo milli-unit và hạng. Lấy các hạng từ 1 đến 3, gồm mọi SKU đồng hạng tại hạng 3.
semantic_slots.entity_grain: product; 1 hàng/SKU; SKU/name/base_unit, sold quantity milli-unit trong base_unit tương ứng, rank trong unit
semantic_slots.filters_group_time: Chỉ confirmed order lines; SUM quantity theo SKU; RANK PARTITION BY base_unit; không áp dụng bộ lọc thời gian
semantic_slots.null_tie: Mỗi đơn vị được xếp hạng độc lập; zero sold không có line nên không vào cohort; lấy toàn bộ rank <=3, kể cả ties ở cutoff
semantic_slots.business_rules: Không cộng quantity giữa base_unit; top-3 và tie policy theo Owner decision ngày 2026-11-09
semantic_slots.fixture_evidence: Snapshot có 12 sản phẩm/3 units; temporary fixture tạo top-3 tie tại cutoff trong EA và các cohort KG/L riêng

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH sku_qty AS (SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,p.product_name,p.base_unit,SUM(l.ordered_qty_milli) AS sold_qty_milli FROM PRODUCTS p JOIN SALES_ORDER_LINES l ON l.product_id=p.product_id JOIN SALES_ORDERS o ON o.order_id=l.order_id WHERE o.order_status='CONFIRMED' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.sku,p.product_name,p.base_unit), ranked AS (SELECT *,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY base_unit ORDER BY sold_qty_milli DESC) AS rnk FROM sku_qty) SELECT sku,product_name,base_unit,sold_qty_milli,rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk<=3 ORDER BY base_unit,rnk,product_id

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH cash_customer AS (SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(CASE p.txn_type WHEN 'CAPTURE' THEN p.amount_vnd ELSE -p.amount_vnd END) AS net_cash_vnd FROM PAYMENT_TRANSACTIONS p JOIN SALES_ORDERS o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.txn_status='POSTED' AND p.occurred_at_utc >= '2024-12-31T17:00:00.000Z' AND p.occurred_at_utc < '2025-12-31T17:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY o.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT *,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY net_cash_vnd DESC) AS rnk FROM cash_customer) SELECT c.customer_id,c.customer_name,r.net_cash_vnd,r.rnk FROM ranked r JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.customer_id=r.customer_id WHERE r.rnk=1 ORDER BY c.customer_id

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH order_value AS (SELECT SUM(l.net_vnd) AS value_vnd FROM SALES_ORDERS o JOIN SALES_ORDER_LINES l ON l.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='CONFIRMED' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'), recognized AS (SELECT SUM(l.net_vnd) AS value_vnd FROM SALES_ORDERS o JOIN SALES_SHIPMENTS s ON s.order_id=o.order_id JOIN SALES_ORDER_LINES l ON l.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='CONFIRMED' AND s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND s.delivered_at_utc >= '2024-12-31T17:00:00.000Z' AND s.delivered_at_utc < '2025-12-31T17:00:00.000Z') SELECT 'ORDER_VALUE' AS metric,value_vnd FROM order_value UNION ALL SELECT 'RECOGNIZED_REVENUE',value_vnd FROM recognized ORDER BY metric

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH per_location AS (SELECT dl.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit,m.location_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS on_hand_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND d.posted_at_utc<'2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY dl.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit,m.location_id) SELECT product_id,sku,base_unit,CAST((2*SUM(on_hand_milli)+COUNT(*))/(2*COUNT(*)) AS INTEGER) AS avg_location_on_hand_milli FROM per_location GROUP BY product_id,sku,base_unit ORDER BY product_id

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH per_location AS (SELECT dl.product_id,p.base_unit,l.warehouse_id,m.location_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS q FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id JOIN LOCATIONS l ON l.location_id=m.location_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND m.moved_at_utc<'2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY dl.product_id,p.base_unit,l.warehouse_id,m.location_id), means AS (SELECT product_id,base_unit,warehouse_id,SUM(q) AS total_q,COUNT(*) AS n FROM per_location GROUP BY product_id,base_unit,warehouse_id) SELECT m.product_id,m.base_unit,m.warehouse_id,SUM(CASE WHEN p.q*m.n<m.total_q THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS locations_below_mean FROM per_location p JOIN means m USING(product_id,base_unit,warehouse_id) GROUP BY m.product_id,m.base_unit,m.warehouse_id ORDER BY m.product_id,m.warehouse_id

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH loc_balance AS (SELECT dl.product_id,p.base_unit,l.warehouse_id,m.location_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS q FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id JOIN LOCATIONS l ON l.location_id=m.location_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND d.posted_at_utc<'2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY dl.product_id,p.base_unit,l.warehouse_id,m.location_id) SELECT w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit,SUM(b.q) AS on_hand_milli FROM loc_balance b JOIN WAREHOUSES w ON w.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=b.product_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit ORDER BY w.warehouse_id,p.product_id

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH stock AS (SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,p.product_name,p.base_unit,l.warehouse_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS on_hand_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id JOIN LOCATIONS l ON l.location_id=m.location_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND m.moved_at_utc<'2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' AND p.base_unit='EA' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.sku,p.product_name,p.base_unit,l.warehouse_id), ranked AS (SELECT *,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY on_hand_milli DESC) AS rnk FROM stock) SELECT product_id,sku,product_name,base_unit,warehouse_id,on_hand_milli,rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk=1 AND warehouse_id=(SELECT warehouse_id FROM WAREHOUSES WHERE warehouse_code='WH-SG') ORDER BY product_id

canonical_sql_candidate: SELECT w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,l.location_type,p.base_unit,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS net_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id JOIN LOCATIONS l ON l.location_id=m.location_id JOIN WAREHOUSES w ON w.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,l.location_type,p.base_unit ORDER BY w.warehouse_id,l.location_type,p.base_unit

semantic_slots.brief: Liệt kê từng nhánh biến động kho của mỗi chứng từ chuyển kho đã ghi sổ, một dòng cho mỗi nhánh; gồm mã định danh chứng từ, số chứng từ, số dòng, SKU, số thứ tự và vai trò nhánh, mã kho nguồn và kho đích, lượng biến động có dấu theo milli-unit và thời điểm biến động UTC.
semantic_slots.entity_grain: transfer document/leg; one row/leg; source/target warehouse, product, signed qty, timestamp
semantic_slots.filters_group_time: Posted TRANSFER only; join each leg via source/leg identity; no summing duplicated pair as one leg
semantic_slots.null_tie: Two rows per valid transfer; duplicate-like valid movements remain; missing pair is invariant failure
semantic_slots.business_rules: Exactly two opposite equal-qty legs atomic; no same-warehouse-location transfer scope
semantic_slots.fixture_evidence: 12 posted transfers; fixture duplicate-looking legitimate leg and corrupted missing/duplicate pair in validator-only case

canonical_sql_candidate: SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,dl.line_no,p.sku,m.movement_leg_no,m.movement_role,src.warehouse_code AS source_warehouse,dst.warehouse_code AS destination_warehouse,m.qty_delta_milli,m.moved_at_utc FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id JOIN INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m ON m.document_line_id=dl.document_line_id JOIN LOCATIONS loc ON loc.location_id=m.location_id JOIN WAREHOUSES src ON src.warehouse_id=d.from_warehouse_id JOIN WAREHOUSES dst ON dst.warehouse_id=d.to_warehouse_id WHERE d.document_type='TRANSFER' AND d.document_status='POSTED' ORDER BY d.document_id,dl.line_no,m.movement_leg_no

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH movement_balance AS (SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,COUNT(*) AS movement_count,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS q FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id) SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,l.location_id,l.location_code,CASE WHEN b.product_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_HISTORY' WHEN b.q=0 THEN 'ZERO_WITH_HISTORY' ELSE 'NONZERO' END AS balance_state,COALESCE(b.q,0) AS on_hand_milli FROM PRODUCTS p CROSS JOIN LOCATIONS l LEFT JOIN movement_balance b ON b.product_id=p.product_id AND b.location_id=l.location_id WHERE b.product_id IS NULL OR b.q=0 ORDER BY p.product_id,l.location_id

canonical_sql_candidate: SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='SHIPMENT' AND m.qty_delta_milli<0 THEN -m.qty_delta_milli ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_qty_milli,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS all_net_movement_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND m.moved_at_utc>='2025-02-01T00:00:00.000Z' AND m.moved_at_utc<'2025-03-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit ORDER BY p.product_id

canonical_sql_candidate: WITH planned AS (SELECT document_id,product_id,SUM(planned_qty_milli) AS planned_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES GROUP BY document_id,product_id), executed AS (SELECT dl.document_id,dl.product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='TRANSFER' THEN CASE WHEN m.movement_role='SOURCE' THEN ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) ELSE 0 END ELSE ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) END) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.document_id,dl.product_id) SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,d.document_type,d.document_status,p.sku,p.base_unit,pl.planned_qty_milli,COALESCE(ex.executed_qty_milli,0) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN planned pl ON pl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=pl.product_id LEFT JOIN executed ex ON ex.document_id=pl.document_id AND ex.product_id=pl.product_id ORDER BY d.document_id,p.product_id
